function.name: Execute
function.description: Executes an external program, an Asterisk dialplan application, or an Asterisk CLI command, and returns the output of the executed command up to a maximum size.

params.label: Execute as
params.description: Defines whether to execute the command as a shell command, as an Asterisk dialplan application or as an Asterisk CLI command.\nAsterisk application commands require an active channel.The list of supported Asterisk dialplan applications can be found at https://wiki.asterisk.org/wiki/display/AST/Asterisk+16+Dialplan+Applications or by executing the \'core show applications\' CLI command.\nAsterisk CLI Commands (e.g.: \'core show channels\') do not require an active channel and can return an output string depending on the CLI command executed. A list of Asterisk CLI commands can be found by executing the \'help\' CLI command.

params.label: Command
params.description: Command line to execute.\nFor dialplan applications, the format is \'Application(arg1,arg2,...)\',e.g.: \'MeetMe(ConfRoomNum,1dxA)\'.A literal comma inside an argument can be escaped by preceding it with two backslashes (e.g. \'SendDTMF(12\\\\,3,1000)\').

params.label: Max output length
params.description: Maximum output length (bytes). For Shell Commands only.

params.label: Output
params.description: Returned output. Empty for Asterisk dialplan Application.

params.label: Error output
params.description: Error output of process. Shell Commands only.

params.label: Return code
params.description: Return code. Values other than 0 indicate abnormal execution depending on the application executed.\nFor dialplan applications the error codes are -2 (application not found), -10 (no active channel) and -11 (command cannot be parse).
